name: Mining and quarrying

bnote.051001: Coal India runs mostly opencast mines. The others are the largest listed thermal coal miners abroad.
bnote.051002: Underground and metallurgical coal miners in the US. No listed Indian underground pure-play.
bnote.052001: Both mine lignite in India. NLC also generates power from it.
bnote.071003: KIOCL makes iron ore pellets. Champion Iron produces high-grade iron ore concentrate.
bnote.072100: India's uranium mining is state-run (UCIL) and not listed.
bnote.072906: IMFA mines chrome ore for its own ferrochrome plants.
bnote.072907: Deccan Gold Mines is India's only listed gold miner and is still pre-production. The rest are the largest listed gold and silver miners abroad.
bnote.081006: US aggregates producers whose core business is crushed stone.
bnote.089102: India's phosphate mining is state-run and not listed.
bnote.089199: Potash miners, the main listed fertilizer-mineral producers.
bnote.089301: India's large salt brands belong to food manufacturers. Compass Minerals mines rock salt.
bnote.071002: Auto-discovered via Wikipedia/SEC EDGAR and verified against stockanalysis.com on 2026-10-21. Worth a human sanity check.

notes: Section B: mining is well covered
Most mining activities have listed companies somewhere. India has listed miners for coal, oil, iron ore, copper, zinc, bauxite, manganese and chrome. Global majors fill the rest.
